name: facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontexts/downstream/votenet/datasets/evaluation/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_object_detection_evaluation: run object detection evaluation by comparing predicted bounding boxes against ground truth files
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_evaluate_function: run the evaluate function to compute AP scores for 3D object detection predictions
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_compute_averages: run compute_averages to calculate mean AP at 50% and 25% IoU thresholds across classes
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_print_results: run print_results to display a formatted table of per-class and average AP scores
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_write_result_file: run write_result_file to export per-class AP50 and AP25 scores to a CSV file

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_eval_det_cls: run eval_det_cls to compute precision recall and average precision for a single object detection class
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_eval_det: run eval_det to compute precision recall and average precision for multiple object detection classes
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_eval_det_multiprocessing: run eval_det_multiprocessing to compute precision recall and average precision across classes using 10 worker processes
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_voc_ap: run voc_ap to compute VOC average precision from recall and precision arrays using 11-point or interpolated method
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.run_get_iou: run get_iou to compute the 3D axis-aligned bounding box IoU between two boxes

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.calc_iou_two_bboxes: compute the IoU of two axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes given their min and max coordinates
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.test_calc_iou: test the calc_iou function with two overlapping 3D bounding boxes to verify IoU calculation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.refactor_calc_iou_batch: refactor calc_iou to accept arrays of bounding boxes and compute IoU for all pairs
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.review_calc_iou_edge_cases: review calc_iou for edge cases like non-overlapping boxes or zero-volume boxes
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.summarize_calc_iou: summarize the calc_iou function that computes Intersection over Union for two 6D axis-aligned bounding boxes

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_label_mapping: read a tab-delimited CSV file and return a label mapping dictionary with integer values
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_scene_types_mapping: read a tab-delimited scene types file and return a mapping of scene names to integer IDs
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.visualize_label_image: visualize a segmentation label image by coloring each label and save it to a file
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.visualize_instance_image: visualize an instance segmentation image by coloring each unique instance and save it to a file
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.create_color_palette: create and return a list of RGB color tuples for NYU40 semantic segmentation labels

facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.transform_points_3d: transform a set of 3D points using a 4x4 transformation matrix with homogeneous coordinates
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.read_mesh_vertices_ply: read mesh vertices from a PLY file and return them as an Nx3 numpy array
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.export_instance_ids_eval: export 3D instance labels and mask files for 3D instance segmentation evaluation
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.export_detection_ids_eval: export bounding box predictions for 3D object detection evaluation from mesh vertices and labels
facebookresearch_contrastivescenecontext.get_instances_from_ids: get a dictionary of Instance objects grouped by class label from vertex IDs and class mappings
